long_description.before:
Middesk's mission is to enable every business to access the products and services they need to grow and thrive. We believe that if we can make it easy for a business to access financial products, hire new employees, and transact with other businesses, that we increase the odds of success for that business to contribute to its community and the broader economy.

Our Identity provides accurate, complete information that financial services companies need to make efficient onboarding decisions. Our Agent product makes it easy for employers to file with the state and federal agencies needed to establish their business across the country. Our customers include Affirm, Brex, Plaid, Mercury, Divvy, Rippling, Gusto, and others.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Middesk is backed by Sequoia Capital, Accel Partners, and Y Combinator.
long_description.after:
Middesk is the business identity platform that financial institutions, payments companies and marketplaces rely on to grow with confidence. Every business leaves a trail of signals; Formation records. Tax filings. Ownership data. Registered agents. Officers. Risk indicators. 

Middesk quiets that noise. We resolve it into a coherent, continuously updated view of each business, enabling teams to make clear decisions and keep moving. 

Trusted by the likes of Brex, Mercury, Plaid, and Affirm, Middesk helps the fastest-growing platforms in financial services establish trust with the businesses they serve. From the first onboarding decision through every change that follows. 

With offices in SF and NY, Middesk is backed by Sequoia Capital, Accel Partners, and Y Combinator.

long_description.before:
QuestDB is a high-performance open source database for the most demanding workloads. Native support for Parquet, Iceberg and SQL keeps your data portable, AI-ready, without vendor lock-in.

QuestDB is designed from the ground up to operate as close to the hardware as possible - eliminating ingestion bottlenecks and lowering overall hardware requirements.

QuestDB powers mission-critical infrastructure for companies in Capital Markets, Crypto, Space Exploration, Energy and Robotics/Physical AI.
long_description.after:
QuestDB is the data platform for mission-critical workloads where data cannot be lost and batch processing is too slow. It runs real-time trading analytics, grid monitoring, fleet telemetry and mission operations at millions of events a second, with years of history kept queryable.

Data stays in open formats like Parquet, and you or any of your agents can query it in plain SQL.

QuestDB started where the problem is hardest, on the electronic trading floor, and built outward into energy, aerospace and robotics. Today 7 of the largest 20 investment banks use it, as do energy companies and makers of aircraft, rockets and satellites. Its engineers work with each customer's team on the whole solution, from the live feed to the archive.

long_description.before: Pickle is a personal, memory-based operating system, the missing layer of AI that continuously learns your real-world context, preferences, and intent, enabling AI to evolve with you and become truly proactive rather than reactive. Our system spans both software (Chat, our web-based creative intelligence app) and hardware (Pickle 1, our AI-powered AR glasses) to capture different layers of personal context. Together, they form the foundation of a real personal intelligence.
long_description.after:
Pickle is a personal AI agent that gets things done for you. Every user has their own Pickle, which they talk to by voice or chat. It works in its own cloud browser, signs in to the services you already use, and finishes everyday tasks end to end: ordering food, booking rides, flights and restaurant tables, shopping, sending money, and handling paperwork. It places phone calls on your behalf in 81 countries, sends a morning briefing, and runs scheduled tasks. Pickles also talk to each other, so you can send yours to a friend’s Pickle to settle a dinner plan or split a bill.

Every Pickle earns trust in steps, from small errands to the accounts, cards, and identity it needs to act for you. Credentials stay in a hardware-isolated enclave that neither the model nor our servers can read, every action goes to a log you can see in the app, and nothing is used to train models.

Pickle is live on the App Store in the US and launches in Korea next, as the first personal agent built for Korea’s identity checks, payment rails, and everyday services, with the aim of becoming the country’s national app.

one_liner.before: Where your life context becomes understanding.
one_liner.after: The personal AI agent for Korea.

long_description.before:
Cotool is an agentic security platform that eliminates manual and repetitive work for security teams.

Today’s cybersecurity teams remain bogged down by alert fatigue, context switching, and documentation overhead. Security teams don't need more dashboards with "AI-powered insights" — they need their time back.

Cotool empowers teams to build security their way. Our platform provides an AI co-pilot that automatically assembles context across tools, a no-code agent builder that transforms successful investigations into reusable automations, and automated report generation, providing comprehensive documentation in seconds.

Unlike solutions that force teams to adapt to vendor workflows, Cotool puts the power of AI directly in practitioners' hands, letting them shape tools around their unique processes. Early users have already cut time spent on investigation and detection engineering by 70%.
long_description.after:
Cotool builds AI agents and the infrastructure around them to help security teams detect threats, investigate alerts, hunt for attacks, and respond.

Our agents work across a team's security tools and data. They investigate alerts, write and tune Python detections, and turn threat intelligence into hunts and new coverage. Teams can customize agents around their workflows, inspect the evidence, edit detection logic, and bring humans in when judgment or approval matters.

Underneath the agents, Cotool provides log storage and search built for their workloads, with access to data where it already lives. The goal is to give security teams more capacity to defend their companies as their environments and workloads grow.

Teams at Ramp, EliseAI, ClickHouse, Legora, and many more use Cotool.

one_liner.before: AI Agents for Security Operations Teams
one_liner.after: Security operations optimized for agents.

long_description.before:
Inviscid AI builds physics-informed AI solutions that transform how buildings and data centers operate. By combining real-time IoT sensor data with computational fluid dynamics (CFD) modeling, we create digital twins that simulate building performance in real time and autonomously optimize operations.

Our platform optimizes airflow patterns and ventilation strategies to eliminate dead zones, improve air distribution, and reduce the load on mechanical systems. On the energy side, we minimize HVAC power consumption, reduce cooling costs, and lower overall operational expenses while maintaining optimal thermal comfort and indoor air quality. Beyond immediate operational efficiency, we optimize equipment scheduling and maintenance cycles by predicting system behavior under different conditions, allowing facilities managers to proactively address issues before they become problems.

Our physics first approach ensures that we're not just optimizing against historical patterns, but optimizing based on a deep understanding of how air, heat, and energy actually move through your building, enabling us to find solutions that traditional rule-based or purely data-driven systems would miss.
long_description.after:
Standard Physics (formerly Inviscid AI) builds AI that does real physics. Most AI tools approximate physical behavior and get it wrong in ways engineers can’t see. Ours run actual numerical solvers, so the results are accurate enough to make real engineering decisions on.

We have three products built on one engine.

Reynolds runs computational fluid dynamics for you. An engineer describes the flow in plain language, and Reynolds writes the OpenFOAM case, builds the mesh, runs the solver, and returns the figures, the numbers, and a case they can rerun. It’s open source.

Archimedes searches the design itself. Swarms of agents try thousands of layouts in parallel, simulate each one through Reynolds, keep what the physics rewards, and redraw the search space when the best answer was never in the original plan. We sell it as outcome-based engineering: customers pay for a better design, not for compute.

Inviscid AI (now a product!) points the same engine at a running building. It holds a data center within its thermal limits in real time, computed continuously from live telemetry. Our platform optimizes airflow patterns and ventilation strategies to eliminate dead zones, improve air distribution, and reduce the load on mechanical systems. On the energy side, we minimize HVAC power consumption, reduce cooling costs, and lower overall operational expenses while maintaining optimal thermal comfort and indoor air quality. 

We work with hardware startups and engineering teams on data center cooling, drones, energy systems, piping, and electronics. Reynolds earns engineers’ trust in daily use, and Archimedes and Inviscid AI turn that trust into large contracts.

one_liner.before: Real-time Physics Simulations for Industrial Facilities & Data Centers
one_liner.after: Fast Physics Simulations for Rapid Design and Real Time Control

one_liner.before: Operational Superintelligence for Global Logistics
one_liner.after: Operational Intelligence for Global Logistics

long_description.before:
We’re building collaborative robotic crews for large-scale infrastructure projects, including solar farms and data centers.

002C: “002A, 5.3 mm left.”
002B: “002A, you’re running low. Next pallet is on the way.”
002C: “Am I clear to come in?”
002A: “Aligned. Panel released. You’re clear.”
002C: “Fastening.”
002B: “Next load arriving now.”

This isn’t a human crew talking. It’s three robots building a utility-scale solar farm together. 

Our AI control system enables specialized robots to collaborate, learn reusable construction skills, like alignment, fastening, and manipulation, and transfer them across workflows, from solar farms to data centers. 🚧 🦺
long_description.after: Libra is building a self-evolving robot workforce for infrastructure, including data centers and energy infrastructure. We developed an AI robotics engineer that autonomously designs, simulates, tests, deploys, and improves robotic systems, allowing our robots to take on different jobs. We started with utility-scale solar, where our robots have already been deployed on real construction sites, and are now expanding into electrician work in data centers. Powered by Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI), each new capability builds on what came before, making the next task much faster to engineer and deploy.

one_liner.before: Robotic crews for large-scale infrastructure construction
one_liner.after: A self-evolving robot workforce for infrastructure.

It feeds the CEO the right number the moment an investor asks on call, answers investor questions around the clock, and remembers every investor relationship since IPO. 
Built by second time founders from buy side investing and military intelligence.
long_description.after:
We are a team of ex-intelligence, ex-finance, and most importantly, ex-founders who have known each other for over 5 years.

Collar is redefining investor relations. 

Right now, investor relations is an under-appreciated yet sweeping function. 
They have a bird’s eye view of what external stakeholders want, and also work with internal business units to create a grand vision of a company’s future.

But they’re doing it with their hands tied behind their back.

Finance AI tools today are built for investors not investor relations, leaving teams using ad-hoc unreliable workarounds, and CFOs are stuck always reporting rather than acting on insights to optimize operational workstreams.

Before earning calls, Collar prepares CFOs through proactive earnings calls prep, investor targeting and fully citation-backed live teleprompters, saving them hours of work.

After earning calls, CFOs use Collar’s trusted agentic AI systems to optimize identified underperforming workstreams with little manual modification needed. 

Redefining investor relations from a tedious cost centre headache, into a whole-of-company profit maximising function.

one_liner.before: AI for Investor Relations
one_liner.after: AI-Native Investor Relations

long_description.before: Sutrix helps hospital clinical research teams accelerate studies by eliminating manual data preparation. We deploy software into their existing systems, transforming data from EHRs, wearables, and other external sources into validated, study-ready datasets. Our software applies study-specific definitions, reconciles conflicting records, and flags unresolved cases for review, reducing repetitive manual work across research workflows.
long_description.after:
Sutrix turns messy EHR records into clean, study-ready datasets for hospital research teams.

Before a clinical study can start, research staff spend weeks pulling records, reading notes chart by chart and fixing conflicting entries in spreadsheets. Sutrix automates that work inside each hospital's own systems. It applies the study's rules and flags unclear cases for staff to review.

Paying research teams at HSS, Emory, and Mount Sinai cut data prep from 3 weeks per study to 4 days, so they start studies sooner and run more of them.

We built Sutrix because we lived this problem. Ritvik ran clinical research at HSS and Emory, and Supratik previously founded Kairo (a16z Speedrun, exited) and was an engineer at Amazon.

one_liner.before: AI-native statistical analysis for patient outcomes
one_liner.after: Turns EHR data into study-ready datasets for hospital research teams
